Amazon’s 2026 Memorial Day sale is now in full swing and today’s 9to5Toys Lunch Break is headlined by Apple’s 20-Core 2TB M5 Pro MacBook Pro hitting the Amazon all-time low at nearly $200 off alongside the most affordable M5 model back at the $1,499 Amazon low ($300 off launch price). Today is also your last chance on these 15-inch M5 MacBook Air deals at $170 off (as well as this 13-inch model), which is now joined by Apple’s mid-range 512GB 13-inch M5 iPad Pro at the Amazon low ($150 off), or up to $300 off open-box units. Head below for a closer look at the details.

Amazon 2026 Memorial Day sale now live at up to 50% off: Apple Watch, MacBook, Galaxy gear, home goods, more

Apple’s 20-Core 2TB M5 Pro MacBook Pro hits Amazon low at nearly $200 off, more from $1,500

In this week’s ongoing lineup of notable deals on Apple’s 2026 MacBook releases, this morning we are highlighting a new Amazon all-time low on the 14-inch 2TB model with the upgraded 20-Core GPU.

Amazon is now offering the 14-inch M5 Pro MacBook Pro with 24GB of RAM and 2TB of internal storage capacity down at $2,599.99 shipped.

Today’s deal is nearly $200 off the list price and a new Amazon all-time low.

This is the upgraded model with the more powerful 18-Core CPU and 20-Core GPU that carries a $2,799 list price. You’re looking at close to $200 off here, the best we have tracked at Amazon on both the Space Black and Silver models and a notable chance to land the more powerful 24GB/2TB model.

For those you who don’t the upgraded CPU/GPU setup, or just don’t want to pay for it, Amazon is also offering $199 off the same machine with 15-core CPU and 16-core GPU down at $2,399.99 shipped. The Space Black model has dropped as low as $2,342, but this is the lowest price we have tracked on the Silver variant.

Elsewhere in this week’s best MacBook Pro deals, we have a return all-time low on the most affordable M5 you can buy, up to $300 off the 32GB model, and even more waiting below:

M5 MacBook Pro

  • 14-inch M5 MacBook Pro 16GB/1TB $1,500 (Reg. $1,699)
  • 14-inch M5 MacBook Pro 24GB/1TB $1,749 (Reg. $1,899)
  • 14-inch M5 MacBook Pro 32GB/1TB $1,799 (Reg. $2,099) – New all-time low

M5 Pro MacBook Pro

  • 14-inch M5 Pro MacBook Pro 24GB/1TB $1,984 (Reg. $2,199) – Amazon all-time low/or $1,949 at B&H
  • 14-inch M5 Pro MacBook Pro 24GB/2TB $2,600 (Reg. $2,799) – Amazon all-time low
  • 16-inch M5 Pro MacBook Pro 24GB/1TB $2,450 (Reg. $2,699) – New all-time low
  • 16-inch M5 Pro MacBook Pro 48GB/1TB $2,850 (Reg. $3,099) – $50 less at B&H

Today is your last chance on these 15-inch M5 MacBook Air deals at $170 off (Undercutting Amazon lows)

We had a steady run of M5 MacBook Air deals at various retailers, but today is your last shot at the special offers undercutting Amazon at B&H. The authorized Apple dealer is offering up some special in-cart coupons that bring prices down $20 under the Amazon lows on a few different 15-inch M5 MacBook Air models.

As we detailed previously there are a range of select 15-inch M5 MacBook Air models at B&H that are dropping down a touch lower than the Amazon lows. Not only are prices going up across the board at Amazon as of this week, but today is your last shot at these special B&H offers, according to the listing pages – “Offer ends May 15 at 8:05 PM ET.”

  • 15-inch M5 MacBook Air 16GB/512GB Midnight from $1,129 (Reg. $1,299)
  • 15-inch M5 MacBook Air 16GB/1TB Midnight from $1,329 (Reg. $1,499)
  • 15-inch M5 MacBook Air 24GB/1TB Midnight from $1,529 (Reg. $1,699)

All three of these configurations are undercutting the Amazon all-time lows by $20. Clearly B&H is looking to get aggressive where it can to remain competitive with the big boys and it has, by and large, done a great job at just that on these 15-inch models.

As of right now pricing is starting to go up across the board on M5 MacBook Air models at Amazon. You will still find select configs at the $150 off point, but you had better get in there quick if you’re looking to scoop one up this week:

  • 13-inch M5 MacBook Air 16GB/512GB from $999 (Reg. $1,099)
  • 13-inch M5 MacBook Air 16GB/1TB from $1,149 (Reg. $1,299)
  • 13-inch M5 MacBook Air 24GB/1TB from $1,349 (Reg. $1,499)
  • 15-inch M5 MacBook Air 16GB/512GB from $1,149 (Reg. $1,299)
  • 15-inch M5 MacBook Air 16GB/1TB from $1,349 (Reg. $1,499)
  • 15-inch M5 MacBook Air 24GB/1TB from $1,549 (Reg. $1,699)

Apple’s mid-range 512GB 13-inch M5 iPad Pro hits Amazon low at $150 off, or up to $300 off open-box

Alongside a host of discounts across both previous- and current-generation iPad Air models, this morning we spotted the mid-range 512GB M5 iPad Pro dropping down a touch lower to a new Amazon all-time low at over $150 off. Or you can score an “excellent” condition Best Buy open-box unit at up to $300 off.

Amazon is now offering the 512GB 13-inch M5 iPad Pro at $1,348 shipped. Regularly $1,499, this is $151 off and the lowest price we have tracked on Amazon for this model.

There have been some wild discounts on the more pricey variants in the past, and even some $200 price drops on the least expensive 11-inch models, but not so much on the mid-range 13-inch. Anything in the $150 off range for the latter is a notable price in new condition at this point.

Best Buy is charging $1,399 for this same machine right now at $100 off, but it does have a notable “excellent” condition open-box offer at $1,255.99 shipped on the Space Black, and down at $1,198.99 for the Silver. That’s as much as $300 off the list price and up to $150 less than the new price at Amazon. Whether or not that’s enough of a difference to warrant the open-box is up to you, but the Silver is significantly less and both options are certainly lighter on your pocket.

For something drastically more affordable without getting down into the entry iPad 11 or spending as much as the new M4 iPad Air, these M3 iPad Air clearance all-time lows are some of the best value in iPads right now if you ask me:

  • 11-inch M3 iPad Air Wi-Fi + Cell 1TB $949 (Reg. $1,249) – new Amazon all-time low
